mettle.perk.athletics.strong_back.descri: You only become Burdened at 85%% of what you can carry.
mettle.perk.athletics.steady_pace.descri: Being Burdened slows you by only 5%% and costs no extra hunger.
mettle.perk.athletics.beast_of_burden.de: You can carry 15 kg more, and a heavy load never pins you: Overburdened is the worst it gets.
mettle.perk.athletics.haulers_stride.des: You can still sprint while Overburdened, at half the usual sprint speed.
mettle.perk.athletics.swimmer.descriptio: You swim 30%% faster and hold your breath 50%% longer.
mettle.perk.athletics.soft_landing.descr: You fall 3 more blocks before taking damage.
mettle.perk.athletics.vaulter.descriptio: While sprinting you step up full blocks without jumping.
mettle.perk.athletics.spring.description: Sprint-jumps carry you half a block higher and a block further.
mettle.perk.athletics.ox.description: You can carry 25 kg more and your load slows you only half as much. Sneak and use an empty hand on a chest or barrel to pick it up whole, with everything inside (it weighs what it holds).
mettle.perk.athletics.marathon.descripti: You can sprint however hungry you are, and sprinting costs half the hunger.
mettle.perk.athletics.freerunner.descrip: Hold jump against a wall to scramble up it, up to 2 blocks above your jump, once before you land again.
mettle.perk.athletics.ironlung.descripti: You hold your breath 15 s longer and mine at full speed under water.
mettle.perk.athletics.ironlung.hint: Some of us were born in the water.
mettle.perk.athletics.mountain_goat.desc: You fall 3 more blocks before taking damage (on top of Soft Landing).
mettle.perk.athletics.mountain_goat.hint: The view is better from up there.
mettle.perk.athletics.couriers_stride.de: After 20 s of unbroken sprinting you find your stride: 15%% faster, and no hunger, until you stop.
mettle.perk.athletics.couriers_stride.hi: Taught by a city’s courier, or found in Letters of a King’s Runner.
mettle.feedback.athletics.haulers_stride: Hauler’s Stride · sprinting under the load
mettle.feedback.athletics.ox: Ox · picked up the %s (%s stacks inside)
